points.why: It says the fit to three on-sales shows only reproduction of seen conditions, not correct structure, and that recalibrating just adds one more fitted point.

It explains that the retry loop was missing and invisible in calm history and recommends adding it, but never proposes disturbing the model with a dip or spike and comparing runs with the loop on and off.
It recommends checking each link with app and backend engineers, including people who didn't build the model, but doesn't explicitly ask to record which parameters were tuned to get the fit.
It asks the team to write down in advance what would show the model wrong, and to run sensitivity sweeps on retry rate and backoff tied to the go/no-go decision.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly says recalibrating on the crash would not validate the model.
